tts_engines.estimate_note: SGLang-Omni's configured reservation as first stated (`--mem-fraction-static 0.60 holds ~19 GB at 16 in flight`, BookForge higgs-models.json, 2026-09-05), and KNOWN LOW since the fp32 vocoder: 2026-11-02 at 16 in flight the WSL VM held 22,290 MiB (23.4e9 bytes) on this card. Not raised to that reading because it is a 16-wide figure, the width is now 12, and a 23.4e9 estimate would refuse every load while the desktop holds more than ~2.4 GB (streaming holds ~3.8). Owed: a reading at 12, which replaces this number.
tts_engines.max_num_seqs_note: 12 since 2026-11-02, down from 16, chosen to FIT and not yet speed-measured. Observed on example-host (RTX 3090 Ti 24 GB) 2026-11-02: the thirdreich fine-tune at 16 in flight, mem-fraction-static 0.60, cuda_graph_max_bs 16 and the fp32 vocoder (narrator 2.0.24 hiss fix) held 22,290 MiB in the WSL VM (Windows GPU Process Memory counter for vmwp) with the desktop at ~1.7 GiB, the card at 24,024 of 24,564 MiB and ~0.45 GiB spilled to shared memory - the WDDM paging that 2026-09-19 measured as 4-10x slower with no error. The 16 before was vllm-omni's own stage-0 value and a measured ceiling at the OLD fractions (11,387-11,584 chars/min, 2026-09-05), taken before the fp32 vocoder. THE deathstalker CAP CERTIFICATE RAN AT 64; nothing measured says whether width moves the safe chunk length. It is also the width of narrator's own batch (v3_served.serve_concurrency), so it moves concurrent POSTs and VRAM pressure together. Owed: a chars/min and VRAM reading at 12.
